draft.about: A gate on CI opens a draft at a run's first gate, when the run has no pull request of its own yet. The draft comes from the claimed branch against its base. Its title is the first line of the issue's title. Its body is Closes #N alone. The rule for a pull request already open on the branch is under takeover.

takeover.about: Each case lists the pull requests open on the claimed branch and the number the peer recorded (0 for none). The peer takes over the one it recorded and its own login opened. Any other ends the run, and none opens the draft.

pr_body.about: The body of the pull request the peer opens, or finishes from the gate's draft. The author session reports summary, door (one-way or two-way), blast_radius (one word), rollback (one sentence) and an optional evidence_note. The peer records the evidence: the gate result with the end of its output, the review panel, and the commits no reviewer read. The body starts with Closes #N when there is an issue. Then comes ## Summary. Then comes ## Evidence, with the note before the evidence. Last comes ## Merge Danger with **Door:**, **Blast Radius:** and the rollback. A blank line separates each block.

frontier.about: The agent-ready issues nobody works on. With the routing label on every issue the factory takes the free ones and the local board offers none. Without it, the board offers them and the factory takes none. Both ask GitHub for the list with the query below, the factory with the routing label added after ready-for-agent.
